vendors.name: Auth0

Above those tiers: Enterprise, contact sales.

vendors.name: Amazon Cognito

vendors.name: Stytch

vendors.name: Logto

vendors.name: Firebase Auth / Identity Platform
vendors.billing_unit_note: Firebase Authentication with Identity Platform bills Google Cloud Identity Platform rates: Tier 1 (email, phone, anonymous, social) per MAU in volume bands; Tier 2 (SAML/OIDC) per federated MAU; phone/MFA per SMS sent. firebase.google.com/pricing lists no cost up to 50K MAUs and 50 SAML/OIDC MAUs, then Google Cloud pricing.
vendors.summary: No cost up to 50k MAU (email, phone, anonymous, social), then $0.0055/MAU to 100k, $0.0046 to 1M, $0.0032 to 10M, $0.0025 above. SAML/OIDC: 50 MAU free then $0.015/MAU. SMS (phone sign-in and MFA) billed per message by region (US $0.01); first 10 SMS a day not billed. Sources: cloud.google.com/identity-platform/pricing and firebase.google.com/pricing.

vendors.name: Descope
vendors.billing_unit_note: Plans include MAUs, monthly active tenants and SSO connections; Pro and Growth bill overages. Free has hard limits (no overages; upgrade required).

Growth starts at $799/mo: 25,000 MAU then $0.05/MAU, 100 tenants, 10 SSO then $50, SCIM. Enterprise: contact sales.
